name: speech-mcp
description: SOTA-grade MCP server for multi-provider voice orchestration (Hume AI + ElevenLabs + Windows TTS) with RAG knowledge base.

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Synthesize speech via Hume AI, ElevenLabs, or Windows Local TTS. Returns a WebSocket stream URL for audio consumption.

tools.name: manage_domestic_utility
tools.description: Alexa-style domestic utility gateway: set/cancel/query timers, query weather, and schedule alarms.

tools.name: trigger_action
tools.description: Elicit physical effects via IoT bridge (Tapo smart lights) or trigger UI notifications.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Semantic RAG search over the speech-mcp knowledge base (LanceDB + FastEmbed).

tools.name: ask_docs
tools.description: Ask complex questions about speech AI using RAG retrieval + LLM sampling (ctx.sample).

tools.name: detect_wake_word
tools.description: [UNDER CONSTRUCTION] Local wake-word detection (e.g. 'Hey Edna'). Planned for v0.3.0. Not yet functional.

tools.name: start_evi_session
tools.description: [UNDER CONSTRUCTION] Start a real-time Hume EVI (Empathic Voice Interface) session with bidirectional audio. Planned for v0.3.0. Not yet functional.

tools.name: agentic_conversation_workflow
tools.description: [UNDER CONSTRUCTION] Multi-turn agentic conversation orchestration with TTS output per turn. Planned for v0.3.0. Not yet functional.

tools.name: manage_voice_clones
tools.description: [UNDER CONSTRUCTION] Manage ElevenLabs voice clone library (list, add, remove). Planned for v0.3.0. Not yet functional.
